name: type:feature
description: New or materially expanded user or system capability.

name: type:bug
description: Observable behavior differs from the expected contract.

name: type:refactor
description: Internal restructuring intended to preserve behavior.

name: type:tech-debt
description: Reduction of known maintainability or reliability debt.

name: type:chore
description: Maintenance work without direct product behavior change.

name: type:docs
description: Documentation-only change.

name: type:spike
description: Bounded investigation whose output is decision evidence.

name: priority:p0
description: Critical, immediate, or release-blocking priority.

name: priority:p1
description: High priority.

name: priority:p2
description: Normal priority.

name: priority:p3
description: Low priority.

name: workflow:quick
description: Compact low-risk delivery with targeted verification and review.

name: workflow:component
description: Compact shared UI component delivery with API and accessibility evaluation.

name: workflow:full
description: Full SpecForge delivery for high-risk or cross-boundary work.

name: stage:intake
description: Raw intent is being normalized.

name: stage:spec
description: Expected behavior and acceptance criteria are being specified.

name: stage:clarify
description: Ambiguity is being resolved or awaiting a decision.

name: stage:eval-design
description: Evaluation contracts are being designed.

name: stage:plan
description: Implementation strategy is being planned.

name: stage:tasks
description: Traceable implementation tasks are being prepared.

name: stage:analyze
description: Pre-implementation consistency analysis is running.

name: stage:implement
description: Approved tasks are being implemented.

name: stage:verify
description: Mechanical repository health is being verified.

name: stage:eval
description: Observable behavior is being evaluated.

name: stage:review
description: Independent code review is in progress.

name: stage:fix
description: Approved review findings are being remediated.

name: stage:converge
description: Final promise-to-proof consistency is being judged.

name: stage:ready-pr
description: All SpecForge gates passed and the change is ready for PR.

name: state:blocked
description: Workflow progress is blocked by a recorded condition.

name: state:needs-info
description: Additional information is required to continue.

name: gate:human-required
description: A recorded decision requires explicit human input.

name: gate:manual-eval
description: A required Eval needs a human-operated environment or observation.

name: risk:security
description: Change affects a security boundary or security-sensitive behavior.

name: risk:data
description: Change affects data integrity, privacy, storage, or lifecycle.

name: risk:api
description: Change affects a public or relied-upon API contract.

name: risk:migration
description: Change includes migration or compatibility risk.

name: risk:performance
description: Change has meaningful performance or resource risk.

name: risk:accessibility
description: Change affects accessibility behavior or conformance.
